_schema_note: date is the calendar date (America/New_York) this cache was computed for, YYYY-MM-DD. tickers.<TICKER> fields: rsi (T-1 daily RSI-14), ma20 (T-1 20-day MA), ma_50d (T-1 50-day MA, used by the stop-loss trend_break_ma rule), atr20 (T-1 ATR-20), pct_from_high (% off recent high as of T-1), t1_close, next_earnings_date (YYYY-MM-DD or null). Recomputed once per calendar date, first run of the day that sees a stale/missing date refreshes it. Reset to empty here since ma_50d is a new field and the cache is fully rebuildable from broker/market data, so wiping it is safe and simplest.
